$comment: Numeric screening/attempt/retry/spend ceilings. Every value is labelled EMPIRICAL, POLICY (a registered decision rule or value chosen without data) or PROVISIONAL (to be revised by a named later measurement). Registered by protocol.md v0.5.0 §§13, 15-16.

spend_ceilings.label: POLICY (hard project constraint)
spend_ceilings.basis: Zero-monetary-cost constraint. Model calls are permitted only on a Gemini API key whose Google Cloud project has no billing account (Free Tier), asserted by the operator via --confirm-free-tier because the API does not expose billing status.
spend_ceilings.abort_policy: If Free Tier status cannot be confirmed, if any request is billed, or if quota exhaustion would require upgrading, stop. Pause until quota resets; never upgrade, never switch to a paid provider without a protocol amendment.
spend_ceilings.sqlalchemy_pydantic_pilot_spend_ceilings: Same $0.00 ceiling; their evidence packets and configs are not written yet.

free_tier_quota_ceilings.basis: Used only to space requests (>= 60/RPM seconds apart). Not a claim about Google's current published limits.
free_tier_quota_ceilings.label: PROVISIONAL (unverified figures carried from the 2026-09-10 draft; the real per-project limits are shown in AI Studio)

screening_ceilings.label: PROVISIONAL
screening_ceilings.basis: Policy defaults chosen before any curation; Phase 6 has not started.
screening_ceilings.revision_trigger: After the first real Phase 6 curation session for any pilot migration, revise once from logged effort, by dated amendment, before any held-out outcome exists.

attempt_ceilings.generation_replicates_basis: POLICY: registered minimum (2) that can show repeatable vs one-off behaviour; not derived from data.
attempt_ceilings.v1_repair_cap_status: PROVISIONAL, NOT EMPIRICALLY SELECTED. 3 total proposals (1 initial + 2 repairs) is a policy prior used only so downstream configuration has a placeholder. The final V1 cap is selected at M5 from the development 1/2/3/5 sweep by the registered rule in protocol.md §5 and frozen at M7/M8 before any held-out evaluation.
attempt_ceilings.v1_repair_cap_selection_rule: Smallest budget b in {1,2,3,5} whose development verified-success count is within max(1 repository, 10% of development repositories x replicates) of the best count in the sweep, with all required safety fixtures passing; ties -> smaller b.
attempt_ceilings.withdrawn_rationale: The v0.3.0/v0.4.0 claim that '>80% of fixable errors resolve within two feedback rounds (BigBag, SPELL)' was not verified against a specific reported result in those papers and is withdrawn; it is not used as justification.

retry_ceilings.basis: Policy cap set in pilot_config.json#retry_and_timeout_policy before any request is made.
retry_ceilings.semantic_attempt_vs_transport_retry: A malformed/invalid/refused model response always consumes one of the repair_proposal_sweep's counted proposals; it is never treated as a free transport retry regardless of cause.
retry_ceilings.label: POLICY

explicitly_not_frozen_by_this_file: The V1 repair cap (M5 selection, M7/M8 freeze).
Final M6 dataset-wide repository counts and splits (Phase 6 supply data).
Final M7/M8 numeric budgets for Arms A and B (needs admitted development repositories).
